answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the veil: Moses put it on while speaking to Israel and took it off before the LORD.

clauses.english: was put over Moses' face while he spoke to the children of Israel
clauses.quote: till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face

clauses.english: was taken off whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him
clauses.quote: he took the vail off, until he came out

doubts: 2CO 3:13 gives Paul's interpretation of the veil, so it was left out.
